narrative.overview: Mara Ellison is a marked contact sheet: three Portra strips, grease-pencil keeps and rejects, a loupe on 07B1, and one email ask. The darkroom safelight sample this file used to describe is retired.
keyCharacteristics: IBM Plex Mono for the sheet, DM Sans for the ask only
Grease circles, star, crop L, and reject X
Misregistered strips on desktop, pull-strips at 900px and below
Authored loupe, not a glass highlight

rules.name: The sheet is the page
rules.body: Do not put a marketing hero above the film.

rules.name: Closed tokens
rules.body: Use the art-direction custom properties. Do not add a font, colour, radius, shadow, or motion the contract does not name.

rules.name: Three rolls on touch
rules.body: 07A, 07B, and 07C stay reachable. Keeps are on the frames, not only in the aside.

rules.name: No hidden strip set
rules.body: One DOM. The resting loupe image is not requested below 901px.

dos: Do keep the loupe clear of the 07B1 circle and 16px clear of 07B2.
Do say the frames are Unsplash-derived, not a real burst.
donts: Don't revive darkroom safelight, trays, Bricolage, or Literata.
Don't use package cards, hearts, filter chips, or a phone number.
Don't invent reviews, prices, or a location.
